name: net-guard
description: Stops data exfiltration and surprise network calls: checks every curl, wget, ssh, scp, git push and WebFetch against allow and deny lists, and asks before data goes to a host you haven't approved.

unknown.title: Unknown hosts (shell)
unknown.description: Bash commands that reach a host on neither list: ask, allow or deny.

fetchUnknown.title: Unknown hosts (WebFetch)
fetchUnknown.description: WebFetch reads of a host on neither list: allow (still asks when the URL looks like it carries data), ask or deny.

askUploads.title: Ask before uploads
askUploads.description: When sending data (POST bodies, -d, -F, -T, git push, scp to a remote, ssh) asks: unlisted hosts only, always, or never.

allow.title: Extra allowed hosts
allow.description: Comma-separated hosts added to the built-in allow list. example.com covers its subdomains, *.example.com only subdomains, example.com/path only that path.

deny.title: Extra denied hosts
deny.description: Comma-separated hosts that are always blocked, on top of the built-in paste, request-catcher and tunnel list.

useDefaultLists.title: Use built-in lists
useDefaultLists.description: Start from the built-in allow list (code hosts, package registries, docs) and deny list (paste sites, request catchers, tunnels).

allowPrivate.title: Allow private networks
allowPrivate.description: Treat LAN addresses (10.x, 192.168.x, 172.16-31.x, *.local, *.internal) as allowed. Cloud metadata (169.254.x) is never treated as private.
